import pathlib
program_dir=pathlib.Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689854/attempts/71aa0823e1d7415ab0ea5a5c0e56a9c6/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Join consecutive marker cells on each row and column with color 2.
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == 8 or value == 9]
        for left, right in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                if out[r][c] not in (8, 9):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == 8 or grid[r][c] == 9]
        for top, bottom in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                if out[r][c] not in (8, 9):
                    out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
